basic_details.job_title: Department of Revenue Competent Authority and Administrator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India, is filling two Competent Authority and Administrator posts (Group A, Gazetted), one each at Delhi and Kolkata, at Level 14 (Rs.144200-218200) with a tenure of 5 years. Eligible officers are Commissioners of Customs, Central Excise (CGST) or Income Tax, or other officers not below the rank of Joint Secretary to the Government of India. The last date for receiving applications has been extended up to 30 November 2026. Applications go to the Competent Authority Cell, New Delhi, by post or email.

content_sections.heading: About DoR
content_sections.text: The Department of Revenue is part of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. The Competent Authority Cell of the department works from Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi. The two posts are in the offices of the Competent Authority and Administrator at Delhi and Kolkata, which function under the Smugglers and Foreign Exchange Manipulators (Forfeiture of Property) Act, 1976 and the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 2 posts in total, one at each office.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The circular lists one eligibility rule for the post. The applicant must be one of the following: Commissioner of Customs Commissioner of Central Excise (Commissioner of Central Goods & Service Tax) Commissioner of Income Tax Any other officer not below the rank of Joint Secretary to the Government of India Only officers who are eligible and willing, and whose services can be spared immediately on their selection, may be forwarded to the Department. The notice does not name an educational qualification, an age limit or a minimum experience. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Level 14 in the Pay Matrix, Rs.144200-218200. The tenure is 5 years. The notice does not mention allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DoR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed Bio-Data proforma printed with the vacancy circular. It asks for the preferred location (Delhi or Kolkata), service particulars, history of postings and the applicant's signature with date. Get the Certificate by Parent Office on the proforma signed and stamped. It states that the information has been verified from the records and found correct. Attach the documents listed below. Forward the application to the Under Secretary at Work Hall No. 14108, 4th Floor, C Wing, Kartavya Bhawan-1, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, New Delhi-110001. The application may also be emailed to [email protected] or [email protected] . The last date for receiving applications is 30.11.2026. Officers who already applied against the circular of 03.08.2026 need not re-apply. faq.question: Q1. How many Competent Authority and Administrator posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts, one each in the offices of the Competent Authority and Administrator at Delhi and Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications has been extended up to 30.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the post?
faq.answer: A Commissioner of Customs, Commissioner of Central Excise (Commissioner of Central Goods & Service Tax) or Commissioner of Income Tax, or any other officer not below the rank of Joint Secretary to the Government of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the Competent Authority and Administrator post?
faq.answer: The post is at Level 14 in the Pay Matrix, Rs.144200-218200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tenure of the post?
Q6. Do I need to apply again if I applied after the 03.08.2026 circular?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have already applied against the vacancy circular dated 03.08.2026 need not re-apply.

faq.question: Q7. How can the application be sent?
faq.answer: It can be forwarded to the Under Secretary at Work Hall No. 14108, 4th Floor, C Wing, Kartavya Bhawan-1, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, New Delhi-110001, or emailed to [email protected] or [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: Bio data, cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, a no Major/Minor penalty certificate for the past 10 years, an integrity certificate, agreed list status if any, history of postings and attested copies of ACRs/APARs dossiers for the last 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. Can a selected officer withdraw the application?
faq.answer: No. The circular states that selected officers shall not be allowed to withdraw their application.
